channel.title: Salua - The journey back
channel.description: My journey discovering my passion for art, science and writing, sharing insights, inspiration and maybe a few amusing anecdotes along the way.

item.title: Sally's arty stuff - Salua
item.description: Welcome to my art gallery, I figured it was time for me to be brave and start sharing my art more publicly. I hope you will love and enjoy this journey.

item.title: My crafty things - Salua
item.description: Welcome to my craft page, I'm so happy to share with you my latest craft projects that I enjoy doing so much. I believe that crafts have the ability to bring things to life and tell the untold.

item.title: The importance of technology in education FR - Salua
item.description: Introducing ‘the importance of technology in education’, my final computer science project in French, published in 2020. The project covers various topics and edtech trends.

item.title: Plant-based recipes - Salua
item.description: Introducing ‘plant-based recipes’, a comprehensive ebook published in Spring 2019 by nutritionist Salua, featuring practical tips, delicious recipes, and expert guidance.

item.title: Why I love Tetouan - Salua
item.description: If I had to describe why I love Tetouan in one word, it would be 'overwhelming', but I mean that in a positive way.

item.title: A walk to remember in Bouanane - Salua
item.description: One cannot visit the city of Tetouan without taking a detour up to Ain Bouanane, Ghorghiz.

item.title: Paris is always a good idea - Salua
item.description: Paris is always a good idea as its one of the rare cities in the world that give you that undeniable feeling of inner happiness and love.

item.title: Happy birthday sis - Salua
item.description: To the one person who knows me better than anyone else: Happy birthday! I love and appreciate you so much, and you will always hold a special place in my heart.

item.title: What’s it like to work with your sister? - Salua
item.description: Building a business with your sister is intense, hilarious, and inspiring all at once. And I wouldn't change a thing. Interview.

item.title: My experience in Granada - Salua
item.description: In the first few weeks of my university studies, I was surprised by how quickly I felt at home in Granada, even with the challenges of meeting new people, learning my way around... Interview.

item.title: What’s it like to work at a big tech company? - Salua
item.description: I wanted to impact millions, I've been working toward getting into a big tech company since day one, but now that I've experienced working at one of the magnificent 7... Interview.

item.title: Tall girl - Salua
item.description: For all the things my height brought me, I love it. For all the times I felt big, unlovable and uncomfortable, I love it for teaching me how to be strong. Interview.

item.title: The ramadan experience - Salua
item.description: As a practitioner who has fasted during Ramadan for as long as I can remember, it is a time I hold close to my heart, it shows me the beauty of taking life back to the basics and being grateful for what I have.

item.title: Mamma mia - Salua
item.description: It’s my mom’s birthday today, so I want to dedicate this post to her stating the reasons why I enjoy and love being with her.

item.title: Open letter to my dad in heaven - Salua
item.description: I wish I could hug my dad one more time, to have just one more interaction, one more laugh, one more anything with him. I never said good-bye.

item.title: Happy new year - Salua
item.description: Wishing you a year full of love, laughter, and success, may every moment of 2025 bring you closer to your dreams, happy new year!

item.title: The art of color mixing - Salua
item.description: Incorporating natural pigments from the earth and plants into my art projects, see how I make my own color palette.
